notes: Input for tools/lot-pipeline/pack-vfx.py. Each row cuts one cell out of a Piloto Studio texture (LOT) and downsamples it to the register's scale (16-32 px) for WorldRenderer::drawSprite's textured path (hard cutout at alpha >= 128, colour = texel * sprite.colour). grid = [cols, rows] over the source; cell = 0-based index row-major (or 'whole'); bbox = crop to the alpha bounding box (square-padded) before scaling; mode: rgba = keep colour+alpha (pre-coloured sources like the fireball), mask = keep alpha, force RGB white (tint comes from sprite.colour), luma = rgb24-on-black sources, luma becomes alpha and colour becomes white, packed:r|g|b = channel-packed masks, one plane becomes alpha. out = [w, h]. Every cell must keep at least minCoverage of its texels after the >= 128 cutout or the tool fails loudly. Colours and step counts named in purpose are the spec's (ASSET-PIPELINE-SPEC 3.4) and live in code, not here.

cells.purpose: steel glint when a guard catches the blow: chest of the striker on the look-ray, tinted the block wash's (0.52,0.60,0.70) x blockPulse, 8 steps, halfWidth 0.12 tile. (Spec named cell 5; that one is a soft dot that cuts to nothing at >= 128 -- cell 0 is the 4-point star.)
warm impact fleck for a landed punch: struck body at chest height, tinted bone (0.92,0.86,0.70) x punchLandedPulse, 8 steps

hard-edged splash for a kill / top-band hit: at the body, tinted the taken wash's own red (0.58,0.10,0.08) x light, 12 steps, halfWidth 0.16. Source is blue-baked, so RGB is forced white here and the red comes from sprite.colour
dust puff frame 0 of 4 when a body goes down: at its feet, z 0.05, grey x ground light, 3 steps per frame, halfWidth 0.20
the Flame cast, frame 0 of 8: one tile ahead on the look-ray, colour white (orange/yellow baked), 2 steps per frame, halfWidth 0.25 capped at 48 px on screen
crescent for a hard (held) swing at the struck body, tinted the hard-charge warm (0.95,0.55,0.20), 8 steps. Optional -- the first VFX to cut if it reads loud
